weather.sourceSeasonal: Seasonal climate trend, not a live forecast
weather.hintRain: PRIORITIZE indoor/covered stops (museums, cafes, workshops, dining, malls), limit prolonged outdoor exposure, and suggest rain backups in notes
weather.hintHeat: High heat/UV: schedule outdoor stops early morning (07:30-10:30) or late afternoon/evening (>=16:00); prioritize lunch, rest, and air-conditioned venues between 11:30-15:00
weather.hintCold: Cool weather: prioritize warm dishes and cozy venues; remind travelers to dress warmly in early mornings/evenings
weather.seasonalNote: Note: Data above reflects seasonal averages (outside the live forecast window); use it for pacing and packing guidance rather than exact hourly predictions.
